title: Story premise EDU099: The Helpful Stranger Wants a Code
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (consumer digital literacy). Hook: What would this code let the stranger do? Takeaway/theme: Treat authentication codes as part of a specific sign-in, not proof for an unsolicited helper.
description: An account owner wants to solve an access problem, but an unsolicited helper asks them to read out a sign-in code. A boundary between official recovery and incoming requests stops the disclosure and redirects to a verified support route.
